translations.web: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
translations.bsb: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.
translations.kjv: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
translations.asv: My days are like a shadow that declineth; And I am withered like grass.
